title: 第5章 震惊金光九丈九前无古人悸动芳心第6章 神秘存在大陆震动九彩之上十品武魂
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
“呵，天赋不知如何，派头倒是不小。”
龙涛连连摇头，斜了一眼阵法内的洛凡尘，随后看着村长、村民们，不屑冷笑。
“不妨告诉你们一个残酷真相。”
“每一个没觉醒的平民孩子都自命不凡，心怀希望，殊不知平民祖上无强者，血脉不行，再怎么努力也觉醒不出强大武魂。”
“而帝国贵族和大宗门子弟呢，哪怕再差的废物也能觉醒出三品以上的武魂。”
“若不是神殿至高无上的女教皇仁慈，你们这些平民怕是连觉醒武魂的机会都没有，一辈子只能被奴役。”
觉醒失败的孩子和家长们心口如遭重击，沉重到无法呼吸，感受到一种发自内心的卑微和绝望。
龙涛情绪莫名激动起来。
“我瞧不起你们，难道是因为你们不够忠厚老实么？”
他大声吼道：“错！是因为你们弱，弱就活该被我辱骂不敢还口，这就是血淋淋的现实。”
平民们的内心被深深刺痛，攥紧拳头却又自卑的低下头颅。
这个时候，一道青年冷笑响起。
“哦？是这样么。”
“那请问你这位神殿执事，出身哪个大家族？”
龙涛回身，看见睁开眼的洛凡尘，而阵法这么久都毫无动静，眼神立刻轻蔑起来。
“看来你也是一个觉醒不出武魂的废物，亏我还以为你是隐世高人的后辈，准备巴结你。”
龙涛大方承认道：“是，本执事就是平民出身，不知他人苦，莫劝他人善，你们根本不知道因为平民身份我吃了多少苦头。”
“如果不是因为我的蜥龙武魂蕴含一丝尊贵的龙类血脉，这辈子都翻不了身。”
他讨厌过去的平民身份，因此厌恶所有的平民。
“曾经的平民龙涛死了，现在你们都要尊我一声，龙涛大人。”龙涛脸上出现强烈的优越感，掺杂着癫狂。

“说我觉醒不出武魂？”洛凡尘嘴角掀起一抹自信弧度：“那你现在可要瞪大眼睛看好了。”
话音一落，似是回应。
“嗡！”
整个六芒星觉醒法阵发出嗡鸣。
黑曜石接二连三迅速亮起。
“唰——”
一颗，两颗……六颗……全部的黑曜石被激活，金光在表面闪烁涌动。
“这？”
龙涛瞳孔一缩，洛凡尘站上去那么久都没有动静，他心里已经给这小子归结成废柴，所以说话毫不客气。
结果现在这觉醒动静……
周遭村子和村民迅速屏住呼吸，再没见识也能察觉出不同寻常的气息，前面所有人觉醒的时候，能有两颗黑曜石亮起金光都不错了。
“轰!”
耀眼金光从黑曜石表面呼啸冲出，腾跃而起。
金光一丈。
三丈！
五丈！！
一瞬间到达六丈，毫无阻隔，更是在继续向上攀升。
“天呐，七丈金光了！”颓唐自卑的村民，发出难以置信的惊呼。
content_en:
"Heh, I don't know how talented he is, but his style is quite impressive."
Long Tao shook his head repeatedly, glanced sideways at Luo Fanchen inside the formation, and then looked at the village chief and villagers with a disdainful sneer.
"I might as well tell you a cruel truth."
"Every commoner child who has not yet awakened is pretentious and harbors hope. Little does he know that commoners have no strong ancestors and their bloodline is weak. No matter how hard they try, they cannot awaken a powerful martial spirit."
"As for the imperial nobles and the disciples of major sects, even the poorest losers can awaken martial spirits of level three or above."
"If it weren't for the mercy of the supreme female pope in the temple, you commoners would not even have a chance to awaken your martial soul, and you would have to be enslaved for the rest of your life."
Children and parents who have failed to awaken feel as if their hearts have been hit hard, so heavy that they can't breathe, and they feel a sense of humiliation and despair from the bottom of their hearts.
Long Tao became inexplicably excited.
"I look down on you, is it because you are not loyal and honest enough?"
He shouted loudly: "Wrong! It's because you are weak. If you are weak, you deserve to be insulted by me and dare not speak back. This is the bloody reality."
The civilians were deeply hurt in their hearts, clenching their fists but lowering their heads in shame.
At this time, a young man sneered.
"Oh? Is that so?"
"Then may I ask, which big family does this temple deacon of yours come from?"
Long Tao turned around and saw Luo Fanchen who had opened his eyes. The formation had not moved for so long, and his eyes immediately turned contemptuous.
"It seems that you are also a waste who cannot awaken the martial spirit. Unfortunately, I thought you were the descendant of a hidden master and I was ready to curry favor with you."
Long Tao admitted generously: "Yes, I am a commoner. I don't know the suffering of others, so I don't want to persuade others to be kind. You have no idea how much suffering I have suffered because of my status as a commoner."
"If it weren't for the fact that my lizard dragon spirit contains a trace of noble dragon blood, I would never be able to turn over in this life."
He hates his past identity as a civilian, and therefore hates all civilians.
"Long Tao, the former commoner, is dead. Now you all should respect me, Lord Long Tao." A strong sense of superiority appeared on Long Tao's face, mixed with madness.
"Are you saying that I can't awaken my martial spirit?" Luo Fanchen's lips curved with confidence: "Then you should keep your eyes open now."
As soon as the words fell, it seemed to be a response.
"Buzz!"
The entire six-pointed star awakening array buzzed.
Obsidian lights up quickly one after another.
"Shua——"
One, two... six... all the obsidians were activated, and golden light flickered on the surface.
"This?"
Long Tao's pupils shrank, and Luo Fanchen stood there for so long without making any movement. He felt that this guy was a loser, so he spoke rudely.
As a result, this awakening movement now...
The surrounding villages and villagers quickly held their breaths, and they could detect the unusual aura even if they were not familiar with it. When everyone in front of them woke up, it would be good to have two obsidians light up with golden light.
"Boom!"
Dazzling golden light roared out from the obsidian surface and jumped up.
One foot of golden light.
Three feet!
Five feet! !
It reached six feet in an instant, without any obstacles, and continued to climb upwards.
"Oh my god, seven feet of golden light!" The depressed and inferior villagers exclaimed in disbelief.
